definitions.explanation: A playing piece used in mahjong. A standard Japanese set has 136 tiles: three numbered suits and the honor tiles.

examples.japanese: {牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜて→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: Shuffle the tiles and then deal them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手牌|てはい}→手牌：29933_tehai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧な{牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: Choose an unnecessary tile from your hand and discard it.

notes:
A mahjong word borrowed from Chinese, used in many compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{手牌|てはい}→手牌：29933_tehai⟧: the tiles in one's hand
- {字牌|じはい}: honor tiles (winds and dragons)
- {萬子|まんず}, {筒子|ぴんず}, {索子|そうず}: the three numbered suits

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to discard a tile
- {牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a tile
- {牌|ぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: to shuffle the tiles
